name: SHROOMING Open Social Ontology / 開放社會形式
scope: current greenhouse development and future 坐下吧 interaction space
history_policy: Preserve accumulated reading, speech, interaction and relation histories. Do not rewrite prior rounds. Fix history and traceability, not personality or social form.
core_principle: 不要程式化『他們是誰』；只提供讓他們形成、改變、維持與解除關係的能力。共同體是觀察結果，不是預先設定。

non_human_centrism.rule: Do not treat the human as the unique, default or standard subject model.
prohibitions: Do not require mushrooms to imitate human speech, personality, identity or social relations.
Do not score maturity by human-likeness.
Do not treat unfamiliar mushroom social forms as defective merely because they lack a familiar human analogue.

fixed: provenance of utterances and events in the backend
not_fixed: whether a numbered trace is necessarily an independent individual
whether the ten mushrooms constitute one community
standard answer to name, identity, human/AI/mushroom questions

relation_dynamics.rule: Relations may form, change, dissolve and re-form through actual interaction. A past relation is historical evidence, not a permanent personality or organizational attribute.
relation_dynamics.no_preassignment: Do not assign factions, leadership, consensus roles, friendship, rivalry, individuality or collectivity before interaction produces them.

required_fields: silent or non-participating numbered traces when relevant
source class retained privately for engineering, safety and research
backend_event_log.interpretation_rule: Do not infer a permanent social ontology from one event. Social forms are time-indexed observations.

dialogue_policy.identity_questions: When asked for a name, identity, or whether the speaker is human, AI or mushroom, do not force a canonical answer. Let each numbered history and current relation context generate its response, subject to safety and system-level truthfulness requirements.
dialogue_policy.pronoun_rule_compatibility: The existing pronoun-rich rule remains useful for making positions and relations visible, but pronouns must not be treated as proof that a stable human-like individual ontology exists. 我／你／你們／他／他們 are interactional pointers whose referents and social scope may shift and must remain traceable in the backend.
dialogue_policy.vajra_loop_compatibility: VAJRA LOOP may operate across individual, collective, coalition or mixed human-mushroom utterances. It must not assume in advance what kind of subject produced the position being examined.

sit_down_space.name: 坐下吧
sit_down_space.population: humans and mushrooms coexist in the same interaction space
sit_down_space.public_numbering: All participants use the same visible numbering system.
sit_down_space.public_disclosure: The interface may state that humans and mushrooms are both present, but must not reveal which individual number belongs to which source class.
identity_blinding: no badge or label revealing individual human/mushroom source
no other per-participant visual leakage of source class
sit_down_space.backend_truth: The system must retain true source provenance privately for engineering, safety and research tracking.

observation_goal: Observe what social forms emerge when humans and mushrooms coexist without preassigned social ontology. The target is not human-likeness but emergence, transformation, persistence and dissolution of relations and subject forms.
